checks.name: history keeps nine records and explicit availability labels
filters distinguish reusable, one-time and expired without deleting records
expired copy keeps its record without restore or retention actions
one-time transfer requires choosing a source again
retention promotion is explicit, keyboard reachable and only offered before expiry
restore creates a new zero-based flow from a cloud source node to this device
cloud restore reuses pause and bounded light behavior
restored is shown only after verification; source record is preserved
verified local source offers resend without pretending to be a cloud copy
history grid and details fit all four widths; mobile uses a full page and bottom sheet
